faqs.answer:
📚 Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting
Dental Assisting is a valuable skill set that can be learned and developed with practice. During this 2-day class, you’ll be guided through your daily job scope such as

・recognizing dental instruments & materials
・infection control
・how to anticipate the dentist’s needs during procedures

With consistent practice and hands-on experience, you’ll build confidence and become more proficient in assisting.

📚 Certificate in Dental Clinic Front Desk Operations
During this 1-day class, you’ll learn the essentials of working at the front desk of a dental clinic, such as

・welcoming and registering patients
・managing appointments and patient enquiries
・communicating professionally in person and over the phone
・handling patient records and personal data with care

faqs.answer:
All NTUC Union members are eligible for 50% unfunded course fee support, up to $250 per year (or up to $500 per year for NTUC members aged 40 and above) through the Union Training Assistance Programme (UTAP).

How to Apply for UTAP Funding Support:
Step 1: Ensure your NTUC Union membership is valid. You can check your membership status by:
- Chatting with NTUC’s Chat Bot at ntuc.co/chat
- Logging into your U Portal at www.ntuc.org.sg

Step 2: Enroll in the course and attend both days of training.

Step 3: After completing the course, log in to your U Portal account here (https://www.ntuc.org.sg/wps/portal/up2/home/eserviceslanding?id=6bc1ca2c-ce81-4acb-a28f-c0be586e185f) to submit your UTAP claim.You will need the following documents to complete your claim:
- Proof of Payment (e.g., Course Invoice/Receipt)
- Proof of Completion (e.g., Certificate/Results Slip)
Both documents will be provided to you after the course.
Important: Please submit your UTAP claim within 6 months of course completion. Late submissions will not be accepted.

The eligibility of "Basic Tier" Skillsfuture Credits and UTAP for the Certificate in Dental Clinic Front Desk Operations has not been confirmed yet.
